methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly for each vendor on 2026-06-15: pushpress.com/pricing, gymdesk.com/pricing, wodify.com/pricing, glofox.com/plans, goteamup.com/pricing, zenplanner.com/pricing (page truncated; Capterra mirror used and cross-checked against G2/Exercise.com), mindbodyonline.com/business/pricing and the official US-pricing blog, marianatek.com/pricing, hapana.com/pricing, and exercise.com/platform/pricing. monthlyUsd is null for any plan where no specific dollar figure is published on the vendor's own page or an authoritative mirror; a null is preferred over a guess.
